claims.claim: Microsoft Xbox One S All-Digital Edition Console (disc-free).
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a large rectangular electronics cabinet with a fine metal mesh front and a small circular logo on the grille; no console shape, ports, disc-drive area, or Xbox branding/label is readable.

risks.risk: Item may not be an Xbox console at all (could be a speaker/audio cabinet or other mesh-front electronics).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the front and back of the device showing Xbox-specific features/ports (HDMI, power, USB) and any readable brand/model label.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a non-identified mesh-front electronics cabinet (worst case: audio/speaker-type with unknown functionality), not as an Xbox.

risks.risk: If it is an Xbox, condition/functionality is unknown (power-on status, HDMI output, controller/OS boot).
risks.proof: A short video clip of powering on and showing the Xbox home screen, plus a working HDMI/USB test.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not tested / unverified working status.

risks.risk: Missing or unknown accessories (controller, power cable, HDMI cable, storage, original box).
risks.proof: A photo laid out showing every included item (controller(s), cables, power brick/cord, HDMI, headset/stand if any).

risks.risk: Potential damage not visible from the provided angles (dents, rust, torn mesh, internal damage).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the mesh and edges/corners, plus a photo of the back panel and any vents/ports.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case cosmetic condition for the visible type.

proof_requests: Send clear photos of the exact item’s front, back, and sides showing brand/model label (readable) and all ports.
Send a short power-on video showing the Xbox boot process and the home screen (if it is truly an Xbox).
Show all included accessories laid out (controller(s), power cable/brick, HDMI cable, any storage).
Provide close-ups of any serial number/label and the condition of the mesh/outer casing and corners.
response.reason: The witness photos do not show an Xbox console; they show a mesh-front rectangular electronics cabinet with unreadable identity. Without proof of the actual item and its working status, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
